title: U.S. Weekly Gas Prices
text:
Retrieved from TidyTuesday:
https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2025/2025-07-01
The data is originally from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), which publishes average retail gasoline and diesel prices weekly.




Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=fct_relevel(fuel, "gasoline", "diesel"))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gasoline" = "#438eff", "diesel" = "#f6ba21")) +
  labs(title = "Fuel Price Overtime", color = "Fuel")
















Code
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Gasoline by Grade")











Code
weekly_gas|> 
  filter(fuel == "diesel") |> 
  ggplot( aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Diesel by Grade")











Code
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=formulation)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(
    title = "Prices by Formulation", x = "Date", y= "Price",  color = "Formulation" )














Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, fill = fct_relevel(fuel, "gasoline", "diesel"))) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) + 
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Fuel", fill = "Fuel")











Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, color = grade)) +
    geom_boxplot() + 
    facet_wrap(~fuel) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Grade")

title: Barack Obama’s Tweets
text:
This data was taken from the Barack Obama Presidential Library created by the National Archives. The data set contains information about every Tweet made by Obama through the @POTUS44 handle.
You can access the data for yourself here: National Archives - Obama Tweets


Code
glimpse(tweets)


Rows: 27,346
Columns: 10
$ tweet_id                   <dbl> 7.989148e+17, 7.989097e+17, 7.989085e+17, 7…
$ in_reply_to_status_id      <dbl> NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,…
$ in_reply_to_user_id        <dbl> NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,…
$ timestamp                  <chr> "2016-11-16 15:45:01 +0000", "2016-11-16 15…
$ source                     <chr> "<a href=\"https://about.twitter.com/produc…
$ text                       <chr> "\"Nothing can break the spirit of the Gree…
$ retweeted_status_id        <dbl> NA, NA, NA, 7.989025e+17, NA, NA, NA, NA, N…
$ retweeted_status_user_id   <dbl> NA, NA, NA, 2458567464, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,…
$ retweeted_status_timestamp <chr> NA, NA, NA, "2016-11-16 14:56:12 +0000", NA…
$ expanded_urls              <chr> "http://snpy.tv/2f3WnrO", "http://snpy.tv/2…


DATA Cleaning


Code
tweets2 <- tweets |> 
    mutate(
        timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
        text_lower = str_to_lower(text),
        text = str_replace_all(text, "&", "&")
    )
